title: Constructed composite stage tail
statement: For composable scheme maps f,gk with specified composite g, a cartesian square for g, opens U,V,L with U intersection V contained in L, and a derived object A on L, construct a morphism from the cartesian g-stage image of the restricted gk pullback of the exact K-overlap restriction of f restricted to L applied to A, to projection pullback of A restricted to U intersection V. It is exactly the stage map after removal of its first site-counit factor: the nested restricted-square inverse, the mapped local-composition comparison, and the g-stage object comparison. The source presents the overlap as the intersection of the two inverse-image opens.

source.place: Restriction compatibility; fixed derived-pullback composition in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: Construct the two inverse-image inclusion maps and their nested restricted-square isomorphism. Map the inverse square component followed by the restricted local-composition component through the cartesian stage equivalence, and postcompose with the fixed g-stage object comparison. All data are the displayed explicit composite; no existence witness is selected.
